title: Kutonga kweMhepo neMurazvo
intro: Fungidzira hutongi uko mhepo pachayo yaipindura mutongi mumwe chete, uko manzwi ezvisikwa zvidiki airema, uye uko masimba asingaonekwi nemaziso evanhuwo zvavo aibatwa nekungwarira. Munhu uyu akagara nhaka humambo hunoshamisa kubva kune akatangira aidiwa, aine simba pamusoro pezvinhu zvemuchadenga nemajini. Asi simba guru rakauya nemiedzo mikuru - uye nguva yekupedzisira yaizoratidza chimwe chinhu chinoshamisa nezvehupenyu nerufu pacharwo.
clues: Ndakagara nhaka yeumambo hukuru kubva kumubereki wangu wandinoda uyo aivewo muporofita uye mushumiri waAllah.
Mwari vakandipa simba pamusoro pemhepo, vachiituma parwendo rwemwedzi mumwe chete mangwanani.
Kunyangwe zvisikwa zvidiki zvaitaura nezvenzira yangu, uye ndaizomira ndichishamisika nekuziva kwazvinoita.
Ndakatungamirira hondo huru yemajini, vanhu, neshiri, dzose dzakarongwa zvakanaka pamberi pangu.
Mutongi ari kure akauya kuzondiedza nedambudziko rakaoma, uye ndakaita kuti chigaro chemutongi iyeye chiunzwe kudare rangu muenzi asati atombosimuka pachigaro.
Ndakaramba ndakamira, ndakazendamira patsvimbo, kusvikira chisikwa chidiki chepasi chachiruma — uye ipapo ndipo chete apo avo vakandipoteredza vakaziva kuti ndakanga ndapfuura.

arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing. (21:81)
